mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(general_ledgers.id) FROM general_ledgers INNER JOIN general_ledger_details ON general_ledgers.id = general_ledger_details.general_ledger_id LEFT JOIN customers ON general_ledger_details.customer_id = customers.id INNER JOIN sales_orders ON general_ledgers.sales_order_id = sales_orders.id

SELECT SUM(IF(general_ledger_details.debit > 0, general_ledger_details.debit, general_ledger_details.credit * -1)) AS grandTotalAmount, SUM(IF(general_ledger_details.debit > 0, general_ledger_details.debit, general_ledger_details.credit * -1)) AS grandTotalBalance FROM general_ledgers INNER JOIN general_ledger_details ON general_ledgers.id = general_ledger_details.general_ledger_id LEFT JOIN customers ON general_ledger_details.customer_id = customers.id INNER JOIN sales_orders ON general_ledgers.sales_order_id = sales_orders.id
